three_papers.question: What methods are used to measure reading comprehension?
three_papers.title: Assessment Methods in Primary Education
three_papers.key_finding: Standardized tests remain the dominant assessment tool despite growing criticism.
three_papers.evidence_snippet: "Our survey of 120 schools found that 87% rely on standardized reading tests as their primary assessment instrument."
three_papers.agreement: Consistent with paper-002's finding on test prevalence.
three_papers.research_gap: Does not address alternative assessment methods.
three_papers.limitation: Survey limited to urban schools only.

three_papers.question: What methods are used to measure reading comprehension?
three_papers.title: Beyond Multiple Choice: Rethinking Assessment
three_papers.key_finding: Portfolio-based assessment shows higher diagnostic accuracy for reading difficulties.
three_papers.evidence_snippet: "Portfolio assessment identified 23% more students with reading difficulties compared to standardized tests (p < 0.01)."
three_papers.agreement: Agrees with paper-001 that standardized tests are widespread.
three_papers.disagreement: Argues that standardized tests miss many struggling readers.
three_papers.research_gap: Long-term outcomes of portfolio assessment not studied.
